name: focusfeed
description: Browser extension to show/hide UI sections across social media platforms.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.start:chrome: web-ext run -s dist/chrome -t chromium --chromium-binary '/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser' --chromium-profile ~/.focusfeed-dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes --start-url https://youtube.com
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
